//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the popconfirm component (pa-popconfirm). NEUTRAL scenarios + the GOLDEN markup core blesses for each. Scope is the popconfirm OVERLAY block only — the <div class="pa-popconfirm ..."> subtree from snippets/popconfirm.html: __arrow (decorative) + __content (card surface) wrapping __message (body, optional __icon severity glyph) + __actions (cancel/confirm button row). The TRIGGER button is a bare sibling in the core snippet (onclick="togglePopconfirm(...)"), NOT part of this block, so it is out of scope. Popconfirm is a popover: positioning (left/top inline style, the --top/--bottom flip, .is-open display toggle) is done by JS AFTER open — the SSR markup a wrapper emits is the CLOSED, un-positioned overlay, which is the layer this fixture captures. See ../README.md and badge.json (single-block structural model) / progress.json (deferred + a11y model).

knownDivergent.keen: keen popconfirm/1 renders the WHOLE component — it wraps the (here-empty) trigger slot in a positioned `<div style="display:inline-block;position:relative">` and stamps `data-placement` on the .pa-popconfirm overlay root. This fixture's scope is the OVERLAY block only (trigger is an out-of-scope bare sibling in the core snippet), so keen's trigger-wrapper + data-placement are extra, keen-specific interactivity scaffolding (svelte expresses the same via callback props and matches the overlay-only oracle 9/9). The overlay subtree itself — __arrow/__content/__message/__actions — matches exactly. Reported by compare-all as KNOWN (not gated); not a regression.

propsVocabulary.placement: logical initial side (top|bottom|start|end) — pa-popconfirm--{placement}; the snippet always carries one (bottom is the authored default). JS may rewrite it after flip() at runtime (out of scope).
propsVocabulary.icon: severity glyph on the __message element (danger|warning|info) — adds pa-popconfirm__icon + pa-popconfirm__icon--{icon}; omitted = no icon (plain message)
propsVocabulary.confirmVariant: colour variant of the confirm button (pa-btn--{confirmVariant}); the cancel button is always pa-btn--secondary
propsVocabulary.class: extra classes appended verbatim to the block

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet shape (snippets/popconfirm.html) for the overlay block PLUS the one convention both wrappers legitimately add over the static snippet: the action <button>s carry type="button" (sensible default preventing implicit form submit — same convention blessed in button.json). The block always carries a placement modifier (bottom is the authored/default side; the snippet never ships bare). The overlay is authored in its CLOSED state: NO is-open (JS toggles it on open) and NO inline position style (JS sets left/top on open) — both are runtime concerns out of the pre-JS-hook SSR surface. Structure is fixed: .pa-popconfirm > (.pa-popconfirm__arrow + .pa-popconfirm__content > (.pa-popconfirm__message[ .pa-popconfirm__icon .pa-popconfirm__icon--X] > p + .pa-popconfirm__actions > (cancel .pa-btn--secondary, confirm .pa-btn--{variant}))). Cancel button is the FIRST action, confirm SECOND (right-aligned row). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-popconfirm(--|__)'). `produces` is a class template with {value}; capability.mjs expands it and cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map + the scenario set. `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-popconfirm modifier — inner text, button labels, or always-present structural element).

placement.note: logical sides; mirror in RTL. All four are real CSS modifiers. bottom is the authored default but still emits a class — the snippet never ships a bare .pa-popconfirm.

icon.note: applied on the __message element; the base pa-popconfirm__icon is added alongside the modifier (exercised by every icon golden). Omitting icon = plain message, no icon classes. keen additionally accepts icon_variant="default" (bare __icon, no modifier) — an EXTRA wrapper capability, not in the oracle enum, so not required of svelte.

confirmVariant.note: structural — produces a pa-btn--{variant} class on the confirm button (a BUTTON modifier, owned by the button component, not a pa-popconfirm class). Cancel is always pa-btn--secondary.

class.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: pa-popconfirm classes toggled by JS at runtime, never hand-authored into the SSR markup — listed so the axis-1 reverse check doesn't read them as an unmapped feature. is-open is NOT a pa-popconfirm--* BEM modifier (it's a bare .is-open state class) so it doesn't trigger the reverse check, but it is noted here for the record: the overlay JS toggles display:none→block via .is-open on open.

deferred.//: No deferred element classes — every pa-popconfirm__* element (arrow, content, message, actions, icon) is part of this overlay block and exercised by the scenario goldens.
